note: Third independent model FAMILY (Zhipu CogView-4; runs 001/002 are Seedream 4.0/4.5). 8 atoms x 6 scenes x 3 seeds x 2 conditions = 288 images. Combined with 001+002: 3 models x 6 scenes x 3 seeds = 54 paired observations per atom (Confidence B with 3-family coverage). Resolution 1440x1440: CogView-4 does not support 2048x2048 (max 2^21 px); the VLM judge evaluates content, not resolution.

scenes.prompt: portrait of a woman standing by a window
a street scene with a cyclist passing by
a ceramic mug on a wooden table
a cat sitting on a windowsill
a modern building facade seen from below

questions.close-up: Does the image show a close-up framing where the subject fills most of the frame? Answer YES or NO only.
questions.monochrome: Is the image black-and-white / monochrome with no color? Answer YES or NO only.
questions.golden hour: Does the image show warm golden-hour lighting (low, warm sunlight tones)? Answer YES or NO only.
questions.symmetrical composition: Is the composition clearly symmetrical with left-right mirror balance? Answer YES or NO only.
questions.shallow depth of field: Is the background strongly blurred while the subject is sharp (shallow depth of field)? Answer YES or NO only.
questions.anime style: Is the image in anime / cel-shaded illustration style rather than photorealistic? Answer YES or NO only.
questions.volumetric light: Are visible light beams or light rays (volumetric light) present in the image? Answer YES or NO only.
questions.rule of thirds: Is the main subject positioned near a rule-of-thirds line (clearly off-center)? Answer YES or NO only.
